Maharashtra Approves Compensation for Custodial Deaths and Disabilities

The Maharashtra government has approved a policy to provide compensation for custodial deaths and permanent disabilities. The policy mandates a payment of Rs 5 lakh for deaths occurring in police custody. This development was reported by Hindustan Times and Deccan Chronicle.
